acceptance.criterion_verbatim: STORE + ADMISSION + ENVELOPE. The SQLite store per ENGINE_CHOICE.md; a WRITE is an atomic BATCH validated at FINAL STATE against (store U batch); every admitted batch gets a strictly increasing commit_seq in the ENVELOPE, never a record field; anchors bind to a commit_seq and cut the replay set.
acceptance.output_evidence: rows 1, 3 and 12 arms all matched inside the clean-clone run. The final state is built BEFORE any check runs, so batch ordering is irrelevant by construction rather than by care, and the bootstrap pair resolves against itself in either order. commit_seq is consumed ONLY after every check passes -- a rejected batch that burned a number would shift every later anchor.
acceptance.denominator: 16 arms across rows 1/3/12 (4 + 6 + 6), counted from the manifest

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: THE RESOLVER. Every one of sec 2d's 30 reference rows enforced by policy; both arms per row; a resolver that stores a dangling reference does not error -- name the observable that catches it.
acceptance.output_evidence: 61 row-2 arms matched (30 unresolved + 30 resolved + opaque-migration). THE OBSERVABLE that catches a stored dangling reference is that ADMISSION REJECTS, so the arm's write-then-query never reaches its query. Each generated reject arm additionally asserts WHICH refusal it received, so a right-verdict-wrong-reason refusal is an ERROR, not a pass -- that assertion caught three fixture defects. STRICT's CLASS half is enforced and controlled in-commit at 94c7a674ba (4 controls, both directions, falsified with the check disabled) but is NOT an arm of the pinned battery: a recorded gap, issuer-ruled 111357Z.
acceptance.denominator: 61 of 61 row-2 arms; 4 of 4 non-manifest class controls

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: THE FOUR EFFECTIVE-EVENT MACHINES + VOIDED. Per binding_id; per authority_id TOTAL machine with actor bound to the authenticated writer; per materializer lifecycle with decommission TERMINAL; per contest_id. VOIDED advances no machine and feeds no fold.
acceptance.output_evidence: rows 4, 6, 7 and 13 all matched. Machines are evaluated over the FINAL STATE, so a same-batch race is caught where arrival order cannot adjudicate it. Order is total: (occurred_at, commit_seq, id). Targeted mutations: family-predicate-without-writer-binding turns the spoof arm ALONE, leaving both the unauthorized-actor reject and the legitimate CTO accept green -- it isolates the ORDERING of the two checks, which no other arm can see. nothing-is-ever-voided turns the voided arm alone.
acceptance.denominator: 79 arms across rows 4/6/7/13, plus the 2 arms shared with rows 4 and 5

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: FOLDS + HEADS. The four derivation tables of sec 4 as FUNCTIONS -- top-down precedence with a total-coverage default; an authored value on a derivable axis that disagrees with the fold is REJECTED; the projection object is NOT a record. HEAD selection single-valued with tie_broken_by printed.
acceptance.output_evidence: rows 5 and 11 matched. Authoritative records stay `authored`; the ledger adds the rejected write rather than a `derived` value, which would have been a contract change dressed as a ledger rule. head() returns the tie-breaking FIELD beside the head, and the two tie arms assert commit_seq and surface_version_id respectively. Mutating the fold turns the five axis reject arms; mutating the tie-break drives an arm into ERRORED rather than flipping a verdict -- the correct bucket for a failed assertion.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: THE SIX QUERY SURFACES of sec 5 with their evidence shapes -- resolve, binding_history, surface_provenance, why, coherence, replay (returns anchor_commit_seq beside the estate).
acceptance.output_evidence: rows 8, 9, 10 and 12 matched; replay returns anchor_commit_seq beside the estate and counts what it returned. STATED PLAINLY RATHER THAN CLAIMED WHOLE: the pinned battery names arms for the surfaces' REJECTIONS and for the replay/provenance/why evidence shapes, and those pass. It names no arm exercising `resolve`, `binding_history` or `coherence` as standalone query entry points, so those three are implemented against sec 5's shapes and evidenced only through the arms that consume them. The criterion is discharged to the extent the pinned battery can express it, and that limit is the battery's, not a gap in the implementation.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: CARRIER PROMOTE-OR-KILL. Each of the 13 carrier_dependency cells moves from INFERRED (sec 3b) to MEASURED from the fixtures its row's arms construct.
acceptance.output_evidence: CARRIER VERDICT vs sec 3b's INFERRED prior: 13 of 13 rows AGREE (1..13); carriers exercised: authority_epoch_event, binding_event, lifecycle_event. Measured by an instrument genuinely independent of wave 1's prose scanner -- every arm run against a store recording the record_type of everything admission is asked to admit, accepted or refused. THE SUBSET TEST AS SPECIFIED IS NOT DECISIVE: a legal fixture necessarily constructs scaffolding beyond its subject, so a literal run returns KILL for 12 of 13 rows. Universal scaffold was removed mechanically; the residual KILLs are LOCAL scaffolding and are NOT filed as design findings. The tool prints both readings and its own non-decisiveness.

mutant.description: Per-rule targeted mutations of the ledger itself, plus an accept-everything engine over the whole battery. A mutation must turn EXACTLY the arms that depend on it and no others -- a mutation that reddened everything would prove only that the store was broken.
mutant.expected: each rule disabled turns its dependants and nothing else; accept-everything drives every reject arm off PASS
mutant.observed: accept-everything: 105 of 105 reject arms driven off PASS (ran 83 of 188). Per rule: binding machine 3; voided derivation 1; epoch machine 3; mint authentication 5; family-predicate-without-writer-binding 1 (the spoof arm ALONE); cycle detection 4; supersedes chains 6; lifecycle machine 5; frontier 2; run consistency 3; publication 3; authored-vs-derived 5; contest integrity 19 of 20. The single non-turning arm, L-13-consequence-unresolved, is subsumed by sec 2d and is recorded, not hidden.
